sentences.en: He said that he is tired.
sentences.et: Ta ütles, et ta on väsinud.

sentences.en: She said that she likes Estonia.
sentences.et: Ta ütles, et talle meeldib Eesti.

sentences.en: He asked whether I have time.
sentences.et: Ta küsis, kas mul on aega.

sentences.en: I said that I don't understand.
sentences.et: Ma ütlesin, et ma ei saa aru.
sentences.notes: "saama aru" = "to understand" (a fixed idiom, not literal "to get").

sentences.en: He said that tomorrow will be warm.
sentences.et: Ta ütles, et homme on soe.

sentences.en: They said that they are coming.
I asked what her name is.
sentences.et: Ma küsisin, mis on tema nimi.

sentences.en: He told me that he works here.
sentences.et: Ta ütles mulle, et ta töötab siin.

sentences.en: She asked if I want tea.
sentences.et: Ta küsis, kas ma tahan teed.
